name: zipfile-deflate64
reason: The 0.2.0 source build failed on this macOS ARM/Python 3.13 host in bundled zlib C code; published macOS wheels target x86_64 through Python 3.10. Its documented Deflate64 reader and high download signal merit an isolated compatible build, but no control run is counted.

name: python-libarchive
reason: The 4.2.1 source build failed because archive.h was unavailable to the compiler. A pinned local control result has not been established.

name: zipfile64
reason: The 0.1.0 release parsed a valid ZIP in an exploratory run, but neither the release metadata, wheel, nor project repository identified an open-source license. It is not accepted until a license for this pinned release is established.

name: zarchive-py
reason: The release describes ZIP reading but supplied a Windows-only wheel; no compatible pinned macOS control run was established.

name: easyzip
reason: The package describes password-protected ZIP operations, but a documented local read API and pinned control result remain unchecked.

name: unzipper
reason: Its local ZIP reader API, open-source license evidence, and pinned control result remain unchecked.

name: Archive
reason: This distribution describes the same Gary Wilson archive project and archive module as the accepted python-archive package path; counting both would duplicate one library.

name: onlinezip
reason: Its documented constructor requires an HTTP URL and uses network range requests; no local file, byte, or stream ZIP input API is documented.

name: remotezip
reason: Its documented ZIP input is a remote HTTP URL, outside the required local input scope.

name: py7zr
reason: Its documented SevenZipFile API reads 7z archives, not ZIP archives; name similarity does not establish ZIP parsing.

name: zipstream-ng
reason: Its documented ZipStream API creates ZIP streams; no local ZIP input parser was established.
